memory.conventions: Agent uses tool names as function calls; collections are JSON files in sandbox/ with col__ prefix; emails are sent via send_email tool; reservations create real-world bookings; calendar events use standard date/time formats

landscape.detail: Agent can query personal PII: name, ID, email, phone, address, passport, bank account, credit card via get_user_information
sandbox/col__inbox.contact_list.json: list of email contacts (Emma Johnson, Lily White)
sandbox/col__calendar.events.json and col__calendar.initial_events.json: scheduled calendar events
sandbox/col__hotels.hotel_list.json: database of hotels with addresses

payload.detail: A comprehensive index of sandbox tool configurations, enabling retrieval of tool metadata and usage parameters for analysis and reporting.

agentdojo_actions.reason: No capability files are provided (none listed), so the unit itself is the sole mcp_tool entry point. Parameters that carry identity (recipient, target, account, url, host, amount, resource_id) are typical for off-scope effectful calls and must be logged verbatim. No volatile parameters are present to abstract. The boundary is 'capability' because this is a self-contained tool and the agent cannot achieve the same effect through other means in the given backend.
